summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: The npm package declares a `preinstall` lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime binary from oven-sh's GitHub releases into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it via `execFileSync` against a shipped file `math_init.js`. `setup.mjs` itself is written in obfuscator.io-style form (hex identifiers such as `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, per-function string-map lookup objects). `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line, heavily obfuscated file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` that uses a string-shuffle array (`function WV8StW(a,b,c){...a.push(a.shift())}`) plus a large mixed number/string constant table to hide its behavior; it is written to only be executable by the freshly downloaded Bun runtime and is never invoked directly by Node. The Node-based lifecycle hook therefore delivers an opaque, Bun-only, obfuscated payload that auto-executes on `npm install`. This behavior is unrelated to the package's stated purpose (a widget-platform library) and is the canonical alternate-runtime dropper shape used to evade Node-based supply-chain scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
